title: Operator Playbook Tiles & Inline Recovery Toolbar for Private Clusters
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design compact operator-focused summary tiles and an inline recovery toolbar to surface actionable remediation for Private/VPC clusters. The goal is to reduce time-to-recovery for networking and upgrade incidents while making cost exposure and rollout state immediately visible. This work covers: (1) a tile grid showing per-cluster health, current rollout stage,-egress/cost delta, and suggested next action; (2) an inline recovery toolbar exposed on cluster and rollout detail views with contextual actions (fast rollback, restart control plane, NOP drain, open runbook, create incident) gated by RBAC; (3) a compact cost-exposure indicator that ties to Console cost ledger and suggests temporary throttles or cache warming; (4) accessibility and density modes for screen real estate in high-tenant consoles; (5) a Figma prototype for usability testing and handoff specs for engineering and PM. Constraints: private deployments cannot call external telemetry endpoints by default, some actions require elevated tenant-scoped permissions, and UI must present safe defaults (confirmations, staged canaries).
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype (desktop density + compact mobile breakpoints) with tile states: healthy, degraded-network, upgrade-in-flight, cost-spike, degraded-storage
Inline recovery toolbar with 4 gated actions (Rollback, Restart Control Plane, Throttle Egress, Open Runbook) and permission hints; actions trigger correct API endpoints in engineering spec
Usability test report with at least 5 Ops participants and >80% success rate on: identify degraded cluster, trigger rollback, view cost exposure
Design tokens and component specs (CSS vars, spacing, color semantics) documented for engineering handoff
Edge-case workflows documented: multi-cluster incident, cross-region failover suggestion, and tenant read-only role behaviour
Security review checklist filled and sign-off from security-design required prior to release
